[UC Berkeley (UCB) Library Dataverse](https://datasets.lib.berkeley.edu/) is a repository where users can find data relevant to the UC Berkeley Community and beyond, including datasets licensed for use in research, teaching, and learning, as well as research data generated by UC Berkeley faculty. 

UC Berkeley Library Dataverse is managed and maintained by the Library’s [Data \+ Digital Scholarship Services](https://www.lib.berkeley.edu/research/data-services) and Library IT. It is deployed using [The Dataverse Project](https://dataverse.org/), an open-source repository software, and is distinct from [Harvard Dataverse](https://dataverse.harvard.edu/) and other [Dataverse installations around the world](https://dataverse.org/installations).

Datasets in UC Berkeley Library Dataverse can be found across three collections: 

* [UC Berkeley Library Licensed Data](https://datasets.lib.berkeley.edu/dataverse/licensed_data)  
* [UC Berkeley Faculty Research Data](https://datasets.lib.berkeley.edu/dataverse/oskidata)  
* [Institute of Governmental Studies Polls](https://datasets.lib.berkeley.edu/dataverse/igs)

While some datasets in Dataverse are restricted, metadata and terms of use are viewable by anyone.

## Dataverse Collections

### Licensed Data

The UC Berkeley Library licenses and acquires datasets for use by UC Berkeley and Lawrence Berkeley National Lab students, faculty, and staff. If you cannot find the data you are looking for, please contact your [subject librarian](https://www.lib.berkeley.edu/help/subject-librarians) to identify a suitable alternative or suggest a purchase.  

Please login to the repository using a Calnet ID and passphrase to view and download licensed data files. Note that accessing some data files requires agreeing to the terms of use and registering with a guestbook. 

### Faculty Research Data

UC Berkeley Research Faculty and their research partners may publish and share datasets through UCB Library’s Dataverse. All datasets are reviewed by a curator prior to publication, who reviews datasets for quality control, metadata, and proper documentation. 

Before using data in this collection, please review the license, any custom terms of use, and contact the dataset author or the [Data \+ Digital Scholarship Services](https://www.lib.berkeley.edu/research/data-services) with questions. For more information please see [UC Berkeley Library Dataverse FAQs](https://docs.google.com/document/d/11FGTM4tjlI5I0eAW4G9HPG8m8F_-n8oGM2iA4HaqT6k/edit?usp=sharing).

### Institute of Governmental Studies (IGS) Polls

The [Berkeley IGS Poll](https://igs.berkeley.edu/research/berkeley-igs-poll) is a periodic survey of California public opinion on important matters of politics, public policy, and public issues. The poll, which is disseminated widely, seeks to provide a broad measure of contemporary public opinion, and to generate data for subsequent scholarly analysis. The poll was previously titled the “California Public Opinion Poll,” which is organized by decade and goes back to 1950\. 

## Data Not in Dataverse

### GIS data

Most GIS data held by UC Berkeley Library can be found in our [GeoData Portal](https://geodata.lib.berkeley.edu/), which holds data for areas around the world, with an emphasis on the nine county San Francisco Bay Area and northern California. 

GIS data in UC Berkeley Library Dataverse is limited to faculty research data or licensed datasets accessible only to UC Berkeley affiliates.

### Articles, Preprints, Dissertations, Conference Presentations and other documents

[eScholarship](https://escholarship.org/) is the University of California’s Institutional Repository for traditional scholarly outputs.
